demand_profiles.demand_source: 24 Polar cloud runs 2026-11-15/16 (20 distinct polar-bu/polar-odysseys tasks, 463 bench-minutes; .context/fleet/runs/*/polar-*/run.json). Explore sub-agents run inside the root workflow, so root messages and each bench's worker log cover the tree. Worker logs: 43 Parallel Search requests (one per web_search call, 0 provider retries) and 0 Parallel Extract fallbacks (all 26 web_fetch calls served by Firecrawl). Conservative count = every web_search + every web_fetch call (71, by toolCallId) aligned at a synchronized start: peak 52 requests in 60 s over 24 benches = 2.17 requests/min per bench (polar-bu only 2.64; steady state 0.15). Recorded 3.25 = 1.5x margin over 2.17.
